sn14.11:1.4: This set of seven offers a unique perspective on familiar meditations. The “light” or radiance is the illumination that appears in deep meditation. “Beauty” is the focus of wholly pure and exalted meditations, such as the meditation on love, or the sight of a pure brilliant color like the sky ([mn77:22.6]()).
sn14.11:3.2: At [an6.41:2.7](), Sāriputta explains that an accomplished meditator could see a tree as nothing but beauty or nothing but ugliness, since both of those elements are present in it.
